scope: Read-only code-competition readiness and fixed model/wheel metadata. No Notebook push, cancellation, competition submission, query-gold read, or default-account modification.

shared_history.note: Matching authorized team-submission views and team-named limits are evidence of a shared submission history, but queried SDK responses do not directly expose current team ID or complete membership. Do not infer a verified membership roster.

final_zhuating_readiness.limitation: These read-only checks support preparing the final version on zhuating, but do not exercise CreateCodeSubmission or directly prove current team membership. Recheck the final version ownership/access and live limits before the single submit call.

metadata_limit: Asset listing access does not prove a future Notebook mounted exact files successfully; retain actual runtime model/wheel hashes and mount checks. Dataset metadata is not pinned by a source slug alone.
